confident_negative_definition: negative DiD row with reinv430 margin > +2 and reinv431 margin < -2
moderate_negative_definition: negative DiD row with reinv430 margin > +1 and reinv431 margin < -1
near_negative_definition: negative DiD row with both reinv430 and reinv431 abs margin < 1

scientific_interpretation.main: On the focused relation-instability subset, official-compatible argmax exactly reproduces saved official predictions. Negative treatment-by-seed rows are not mostly infinitesimal ties: only a small fraction have both reinvest margins within ±1, while many have moderate-to-confident opposite-signed margins. This supports a real relation-preference polarization across seeds rather than mere tie-breaking noise.
scientific_interpretation.scope: The subset was deliberately enriched for unstable relation rows and controls, so accuracies are not full-EWoK estimates. It is a mechanism-local measurement for interpreting the old inherited-tokenizer route and for analyzing the corrected-tokenizer runs once they finish.
